title: Mexican Chocolate Stir Fry
description: A vegan twist on a classic stir fry, featuring the deep flavors of Mexican chocolate. This dish comes together in just a few minutes and is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the bell peppers and onion and cook until tender, about 4-5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Mexican chocolate and stir fry sauce and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the chocolate is melted and the sauce is heated through.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
